title: Godement-Jacquet gamma factors of distinguished representations of $\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathbb{F}_q)$
summary: Let $k$ be a finite field of characteristic $p$. In the 1960s, Kondo attached non-abelian Gauss sums to irreducible $\mathbb{C}$-representations of $\mathrm{GL}_n(k)$, and computed them in terms of Green parameters. On the other hand, the Godement-Jacquet functional equation in which they occur was established by Macdonald in the 1980s. We first revisit Macdonald's and Kondo's results with a different perspective, in the process of generalizing their constructions to representations with coefficients in $\mathbb{Z}[\sqrt{p}^{-1},μ_p]$-algebras.
